command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '===OMEGA_CHECKOUTS==='
for p in /home/ai-core-node/omega-bootstrap/oMEGA /workspace/oMEGA /home/ai-core-node/oMEGA; do
  if [ -d "$p/.git" ]; then
    echo "CHECKOUT=$p"
    printf 'HEAD='; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'BRANCH='; git -C "$p" branch --show-current
    printf 'DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C "$p" status --porcelain | wc -l
    printf 'LAST='; git -C "$p" log -1 --pretty='%h %cI %s'
  fi
done
echo '===OMEGA_USER_SERVICES==='
for s in omega-cognition-supervisor.service omega-outer-bridge-worker.service omega-master-bridge.service omega-chatgpt-mcp.service omega-local-effect-adapter.service frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service frankenstein-local-bridge.service; do
  printf '%s=' "$s"; systemctl --user is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || true
done
echo '===RUNTIME_ROOTS==='
for p in /workspace/omega_runtime /home/ai-core-node/omega_runtime /home/ai-core-node/omega-bootstrap; do [ -e "$p" ] && stat -c '%F %n' "$p"; done
